# Golden expected-edges fixture: tests/fixtures/golden/go
#
# Format, xfail marker, resolution-kind column and scope: see
# tests/fixtures/golden/python/expected_edges.txt and tests/common/golden.rs.
# Only CALLS edges are scored.
#
# Qualnames are <dir>/<file stem>.<name>: lidx models a Go file, not a
# package, as the module.
#
# Baseline measured 2026-09-23: precision 1.0 (5/5), recall 1.0 (5/5),
# 6 known-failing lines. After #75 (stricter name fallback and visibility
# rules): precision 1.0 (8/8), recall 1.0 (8/8), 6 known-failing -- the two
# new UNRESOLVED lines below exercise cases that resolved *wrongly* before
# #75 (see that commit's PR description for what each one used to bind to).

# Plain call to an unexported same-file function. other.localUtil is a
# same-named decoy.
caller/caller.Entry CALLS caller/caller.localUtil exact

# Unexported function in another file of the same package. Lands on the
# right target via the bare_name fallback, so no tier is pinned.
caller/caller.CallSamePackageOtherFile CALLS caller/sibling.siblingUtil

# Package-qualified call to an exported function across packages.
# other.FormatGreeting is a same-named decoy.
caller/caller.CallImportedHelper CALLS helper/helper.FormatGreeting import

# Exported function calling an unexported one in its own package.
# other.decorate is a same-named decoy.
helper/helper.FormatGreeting CALLS helper/helper.decorate exact

# Method call on the receiver. LoudGreeter.format is a same-named decoy.
greeter/greeter.Greeter.Greet CALLS greeter/greeter.Greeter.format receiver_type

# Receiver-typed call. LoudGreeter.Greet is a same-named decoy.
caller/caller.CallReceiverTyped CALLS greeter/greeter.Greeter.Greet receiver_type

# Promoted method through embedding: Dog embeds Animal. Cat.Speak is a
# same-named decoy.
caller/caller.CallInherited CALLS animals/animals.Animal.Speak receiver_type

# Interface call through Speaker. Cat.Say is a same-named decoy.
caller/caller.CallInterface CALLS animals/animals.Speaker.Say

# Ambiguous name: Run exists in ambiguous_a and ambiguous_b; the call is
# qualified with ambiguous_a.
caller/caller.CallAmbiguous CALLS ambiguous_a/run.Run import

# External call: fmt is never indexed, so this binds to the external stub
# symbol (issue #80) instead of staying unresolved.
caller/caller.CallExternal CALLS ext:fmt.Sprint external

# Cross-package incoming call into caller.Entry. Lands on the right
# target via the bare_name fallback, so no tier is pinned.
downstream/downstream.UseEntry CALLS caller/caller.Entry

# --- Issue #75: stricter name fallback and visibility rules ---

# Plain call to an unexported function in its own package -- unaffected
# by the new visibility guard (same package).
secretpkg/secret.CallLocally CALLS secretpkg/secret.secretUtil exact

# Bare, unqualified call to secretUtil, whose only definition
# (secretpkg.secretUtil) is unexported and in a different package. Before
# #75 this was the sole same-language candidate the bare-name fallback
# found and bound to -- wrong, since an unexported name is not visible
# outside its own package. #75's visibility guard must refuse it.
prober/prober.CallRemotely CALLS UNRESOLVED

# Bare, receiver-less call to Process, whose only definition
# (Widget.Process) is a method. Before #75 the bare-name fallback bound to
# it anyway -- wrong, since a receiver-less call can never dispatch to an
# instance method. #75's bare-call guard must refuse it.
bare_call_pkg/bare_call.BareCaller CALLS UNRESOLVED

# --- Issue #421: nested, chained and closure calls ---

# Calls nested in the arguments of another call; len() is a builtin.
nested/nested.NestedArgs CALLS nested/nested.Outer exact
nested/nested.NestedArgs CALLS nested/nested.Inner exact

# The head of a chain is a call too; B and C are typed through the declared
# result of the call before them.
nested/nested.Chain CALLS nested/nested.A exact
nested/nested.Chain CALLS nested/nested.Builder.B receiver_type
nested/nested.Chain CALLS nested/nested.Builder.C receiver_type

# Calls in closures belong to the enclosing declaration; a package-level
# variable's initializer is sourced from the module, like its value references.
nested/nested.GoClosure CALLS nested/nested.Helper exact
nested/nested.DeferClosure CALLS nested/nested.Helper exact
nested/nested.TestRun CALLS nested/nested.Helper exact
# t.Run is a method of testing.T, a foreign type: an external stub, never a
# repo symbol.
nested/nested.TestRun CALLS ext:testing.T.Run external
nested/nested CALLS nested/nested.Helper exact
nested/nested.Builder.C CALLS nested/nested.Helper exact

# --- Issue #422: calls bound through imports and packages ---

# path.Join / filepath.Join are the standard library's, never the repo's
# same-named Join; they bind to external stubs keyed by import path.
stdlib_shadow/use.JoinAll CALLS ext:path.Join external
stdlib_shadow/use.JoinAll CALLS ext:path/filepath.Join external
# A bare name is the package's own function, found in a sibling file.
stdlib_shadow/use.JoinLocal CALLS stdlib_shadow/shadow.Join exact

# Both validate_pkga and validate_pkgb declare Validate; the caller imports one.
validate_caller/caller.UseValidate CALLS validate_pkgb/b.Validate import
# A conversion to a repo type is no call edge.
validate_caller/caller.Convert CALLS UNRESOLVED
# A bare call to a function declared in a sibling file of the package.
validate_caller/caller.UseLocal CALLS validate_caller/sibling.sibling exact

# The imported package's declared name (`package renamed`) differs from its
# directory (renamed_dir): the call binds to it, not to a name guess.
renamed_caller/caller.UseRenamed CALLS renamed_dir/renamed.Do import

# A function-typed package variable and a constant are no declarations: the
# call to Printer stays unresolved (never bound to the variable), Real binds.
fnvar/use.Use CALLS fnvar/vars.Real exact
fnvar/use.Use CALLS UNRESOLVED

# A nested module (its own go.mod, unrelated path) imports a package of the
# root module that is also in the repository: bound, not an external stub.
nestedmod/use.UseHelper CALLS helper/helper.FormatGreeting import

# A package vendored into the repository (vendor/<import path>).
vendor_user/use.UseVendored CALLS vendor/example.com/thirdparty/lib/lib.Vendored import

# --- Issue #423: typed receivers ---

# A constructor's declared result types the local.
typed/client.viaConstructor CALLS typed/server.NewServer exact
typed/client.viaConstructor CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# A chain is typed link by link.
typed/client.viaChain CALLS typed/server.NewServer exact
typed/client.viaChain CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# `&Server{}`, `Server{}`, `var c Server`, `var d *Server`.
typed/client.viaLiterals CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# A struct field's declared type.
typed/client.Client.viaField CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# A method promoted from an embedded type, through a field.
typed/client.Client.viaEmbedded CALLS typed/server.Base.Ping receiver_type
# A range value over a slice-typed field.
typed/client.Client.eachServer CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# `conn net.Conn` is the standard library's, never Report.Close.
typed/client.Client.run CALLS ext:net.Conn.Close external
# `var b bytes.Buffer; b.String()` is no edge to Report.String.
typed/client.viaBuffer CALLS ext:bytes.Buffer.String external
# `x.(*Server)` names the type; an interface{} local names none.
typed/client.viaAssertion CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
typed/client.viaAssertion CALLS UNRESOLVED
# A type switch binds the case type in its clause.
typed/client.viaSwitch CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
typed/client.viaSwitch CALLS typed/server.Report.String receiver_type
# A package-level variable is typed from its initializer (the initializer's own
# call is sourced from the module).
typed/client CALLS typed/server.NewServer exact
typed/client.viaGlobal CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# A parameter used inside a closure.
typed/client.viaClosure CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
# Generic receivers: the method is Set.Add, not Set[T].Add.
typed/set.Set.AddAll CALLS typed/set.Set.Add receiver_type
typed/set.useSet CALLS typed/set.Set.Add receiver_type
# Another package's constructor, parameter and declared type.
typed_user/user.UseImported CALLS typed/server.NewServer import
typed_user/user.UseImported CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
typed_user/user.UseParam CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
typed_user/user.UseVar CALLS typed/server.Server.Handle receiver_type
